result: h=(U,eta V) is a linear automorphism of F (non-diagonal in (X,Y) frame; block matrix [[aI,bI],[bI,aI]], a=(1+eta)/2,b=(1-eta)/2). Aut(X) contains D6=<h,tau> order 12. Ages: h,h^5 junior (1/2 at C_U resp. C_V); h^2,h^4 age 1/2 resp 2; h^3 age 3/2; h^k tau: k odd fixes planes {V=lam U} (lam^6=-1, these six planes lie on X), age 1; k even fixes curves, age 3/2. Target: A_hat = prod(U_i^2-V_i^2)/64, swap-odd; V-degrees 0,6 (K3, char eta^3) and 2,4 (sixth-root pair, chars eta^5, eta).
